notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce a content update for Wool at the Gates![/p][p]Along with this update, Wool at the Gates will be [b]20% off[/b] during the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b][/p][p][b]September 29 – October 6[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Here’s everything included in this update: [/p][p][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][p][/p][h3]Troops[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rider[/b] - Berserker Rogue (Human)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sorcerer[/b] - Mage Warlock (Orc)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Archer[/b] - Mercenary Ranger (Elf)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/b8e1da01e2a2f9d5d9465f2667d521fb767bd455.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Towers[/h3][list][*][p][b]Bombarder[/b] - Mage Mercenary (Human)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Totem[/b] - Enchanter Summoner (Orc)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Undying[/b] - Summoner Warrior (Elf)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/74e7cdce1755658088085bc5716d6e9ba2399005.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Perks[/h3][p]12 in total (4 per faction)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/631927cd3347c51a867ad0962e155ea1fe93f74e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Mouse Movement[/h2][p]Mouse movement is now supported! In order to integrate this alongside the existing WASD movement, we've added a separate control scheme designed around mouse movement that can be enabled in the Settings.[/p][p][/p][p]Enabling the new control scheme lets you hold [b]right-click[/b] to move your hero toward the cursor. Other inputs are remapped to better fit MOBA-style controls, such as hero abilities mapped to [b]Q, W, E[/b]. We think this layout works well, but all inputs are fully rebindable so you can adjust them to your preference.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/e5f129b5dea9bc2d4b469b9c82a88f35c9ba9a43.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p][i]Enlightenment[/i] perk is now Tier 1[/p][/*][*][p]Hero ability tooltips now display cooldowns[/p][/*][*][p]Loading-screen tips each appear once before repeating[/p][/*][*][p]Vaelith [i]Smoke Bomb[/i] now deals damage over time and no longer draws aggro[/p][/*][*][p]Summoned units can’t be attacked until they finish spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Necromancers now prioritize targeting low-health enemies[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Armored Sheep: more health, slightly less ranged damage reduction[/p][/*][*][p]Big Horn: basic attack damage increased[/p][/*][*][p]Assassin: health and basic attack damage increased[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbowman: basic attack damage reduced, bonus damage vs. high-health enemies increased[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel: basic attack damage increased[/p][/*][*][p]Shaman: health increased[/p][/*][*][p]Waiterra level: difficulty increased on rounds 9, 11, 12 and fewer flying enemies on round 6[/p][/*][*][p]Vaelith's basic attack: damage increased, cooldown reduced[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Damage-over-time effects now apply correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Barracks troop count tooltip updates correctly with [i]Massive Army[/i] perk[/p][/*][*][p]Corrupted saves files are ignored instead of causing the game to enter an unplayable error state[/p][/*][*][p]Solitary tower bonus damage now loads correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Troops can again be placed on Ovismaw ramps[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hit detection for Zagzul and Grizzly sweeping attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Hero Level-Up tip no longer breaks and prevents you from starting the next round[/p][/*][*][p]Concussive Blows now only increases damage of attacks that trigger it[/p][/*][*][p]Bonebow [i]Melee Volley[/i] stab now correctly classified as melee[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next[/h2][p][/p][h3]More content[/h3][p]We’re currently developing the final set of troops and towers, which will complete all possible class combinations in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Game Mode - [i]Wild Mode[/i][/h3][p]We've been prototyping a new game mode that is inspired by the randomized market mechanics of autobattlers. It's designed to add variety to existing content by making each playthrough of a level feel unique and encouraging players to adapt their strategy based on the options available. More details coming soon![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.content: [p]We're so excited to get out our first content update! To celebrate, Wool at the Gates will be on a 15% off sale from Aug 4th - 14th. [/p][p][/p][h2]Waiterra - Canyon Level[/h2][p]This update includes the new Waiterra level! The level comes with new modifiers, challenges, and 3 new enemy types: Flying Sheep, Armored Sheep, and Bighorns.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/4351c6753fe9be92fc70bb5d0be4931a91d3f295.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Vaelith - Elf Rogue Hero[/h2][p]We've also added a new hero, Vaelith, who can throw smoke bombs on the terrain to create kill zones and protect allies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/b1de5ad957cc69efe8b65eedf5d94a87a10a32b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Auto Troop Respawn[/h2][p]We added the highly requested feature for your troops to auto-respawn. The auto-respawn system attempts to mimic how most players would normally use respawn troops, so that players can just focus on the battle without having to constantly monitor the status of the city's troops. Manual respawn is still supported, and auto-respawn can be disabled in the settings menu if you prefer having full control.[/p][p][/p][h2]Eye Form can now attack flying enemies[/h2][p]Eye Form now has a ranged attack that shoots magical projectiles at flying enemies. Having a default way to attack flying enemies should hopefully make it less frustrating to play as a melee hero during these rounds.  [/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life[/h2][list][*][p]Improved troop behavior: [/p][list][*][p]Ranged troops no longer run awkwardly out of position / into range of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Melee troops and Summoned can now move across the map in response to allies taking damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ranged troops, enemies, and your hero now consider line of sight when attacking[/p][/*][*][p]The troop tooltip shows for the selected troop type in the filter menu[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked visuals of Player Hero HUD to be more readable[/p][/*][*][p]Game visual quality is now more consistent across different resolutions and fixed shadow artifacts[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals and feedback for Cripple Trap and Arcane Devour abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Boomer enemies now do more damage to troops and your hero[/p][/*][*][p]Towers and ranged troops now prioritize ranged enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Building upgrades no longer animate when showing building previews in order to improve clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the tutorial to better explain faction points, flying enemies, and auto-respawn of troops[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded hero ability challenge requirement to be more clear[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded the class bonus descriptions of double attack, counter attack, imprint, and elite summoned to be more clear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed bug where you sometimes could no longer build after choosing a new hero ability[/p][/*][*][p]Many other small bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Upcoming[/h2][p]Our main focus is still to add more content. We’re still finalizing our plan for the next update, but it will most likely include new perks, troops and towers along with a new level.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update and Steam Summer Sale
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We just wanted to announce that Wool at the Gates is 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p][/p][p]We also wanted to share a sneak peak of what we're working on for our next update. Here's a screenshot of an early version of a new level. It's still a work in progress, but it's a canyon-themed map with long, winding ridges and gorges that enemies have to path through.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/cfa7b89998506c25ed1beb1947bbf5da19ee413c.png"][/img][/p][p]The update will also include a new [b]Elf Rogue hero[/b]. Additionally, we've been working on some quality of life fixes, such as the highly-requested option to have your troops automatically respawn (you can still disable this in the settings if you prefer more control). [/p][p][/p][p]We don't have a set release date for the update yet because we're still finalizing the new content, but stay tuned for more info coming soon![/p]

notes.title: Save System Fix - Patch 0.3.3
notes.content: The game's save system now batches saves instead of writing saves immediately, preventing multiple saves from writing to the same file consecutively. Some users were experiencing issues where repeated saves to the same file were failing, causing the game to throw errors and stop functioning properly. This change should hopefully fix this issue.

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Now that Wool at the Gates has launched into Early Access, we wanted to share our roadmap for what we’ll be focusing on in the short term. Our main priority is to add new content to the game.

Additionally, we’ve heard your feedback about the meta progression system and are considering ways to improve it. We’re also exploring options to increase replayability, such as potentially adding a free play mode. We're still working through the details of these ideas and will share any new information as we move forward.

Thanks so much for your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for the next content update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/3de5094f3c656f679e0bce99214fe047d9a67512.png[/img]

notes.title: Complete Level Achievement bug fix - Patch 0.3.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug where forfeiting a map was considered completing it. This allowed players to unlock Hindell from forfeiting Gilia, and unlocked any achievement for completing the level if you forfeiting on the level.

notes.title: Wool at the Gates available now!
notes.content:
We are so excited to share that Wool at the Gates has launched into Early Access! 

Build your cities and crush the sheep rebellion! The game currently has 4 levels (not including the tutorial), which is ~3 hours of campaign content. Replay levels on higher difficulties, complete challenges, and to test your defenses in Endless Mode. 

This is just the beginning. We'll continue to add content and quality of life improvements. A roadmap is coming soon, but you can expect more levels, heroes, troops, towers, perks, and more in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/555ef51802f926f1a88ead9eb4b30b72366f9c78.png[/img]

Thank you so much for all the feedback you've shared so far. It has brought the game to what it is today, and we can't wait to see how the game evolves going forward. 

Join our community on Discord and follow us here on our Steam page to stay updated on the game's development.

-Mr. & Mrs. Creature

notes.title: Demo Save Import Map Unlock Bug Fix - Patch 0.3.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the second map (Hindell) wouldn't be unlocked if you imported your save data from the demo that had the first map (Gilia) completed.

notes.title: Demo Update - Endless Mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just pushed a new update to the Wool at the Gates demo that includes [b]Endless Mode[/b]!

After completing a level, you now have the option to continue defending your city against an endless series of randomly generated enemy waves. Earn wool for each round you survive and set new records for the challenges you've completed.

This mode is experimental and has room for improvement. We already have some ideas — like adding support for additional building upgrades — but we’d love to get your feedback on this early version and to know how many rounds your city was able to survive!

Also in this update:
[list]
[*]Added new Training Grounds building in Endless Mode that allows you to buy class points
[*]Level 4 Hero Abilities and Class Bonuses
[*]Reworked some perks to scale better with your hero leveling up
[*]Added a hot-key for selecting all Summoned units
[*]Challenges can be enabled even if you’ve already completed them
[*]Other small bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements
[/list]

[b]The Early Access release launches on May 20[/b]. Please keep sharing any feedback on the demo until then!

Sincerely,
Mr. & Mrs. Creature

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much to those who have played our demo and filled out our feedback survey! We've been blown away not just by how many of you took the time to give feedback, but by how thoughtful and in-depth the responses have been. It's so inspiring to see what you're hoping for in the game - your feedback is guiding the direction of Wool at the Gates and we are so excited about where it's headed. 

One of the most requested features was [b]Endless Mode[/b], so we've decided to try to add it for the Early Access release, along with some other quality-of-life improvements that many suggested. Therefore we have moved the release date to May 20th in order to have enough time for these changes.

Thank you again for your support. Also keep an eye out for updates to the demo if you're interested in helping beta test the new features before release.

Mr. & Mrs. Creature

notes.title: Steam City Builder & Colony Sim Fest
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the Wool at the Gates demo is featured in [b]Steam City Builder & Colony Sim Fest March 24 - 31[/b]! Check it out and let us know what you think in our in-game survey, Discord, or any other way you can reach us.

Plan your tactics. Build your defenses. Slay them sheep.

-Mr. & Mrs. Creature

notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who playtested our previous demo during the October Next Fest. We received so much valuable feedback and have been hard at work making major improvements to the game. This new demo is a true representation of how the game will be in our upcoming Early Access release. We're really excited about these improvements - the major ones are listed below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065395/cf54983b3c7f5e98850ac53a76bfc7ddd50cc62a.png[/img]

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Faction - Elves:[/b] Elves have joined the Human and Orc factions and come with new heroes, towers, troops and perks
[*][b]Subclasses:[/b] Choose your class bonuses from 3 different options for each class, greatly expanding on your playstyle and strategic options. Choose between gaining a new subclass bonus or leveling up your current ones for a given class.
[*][b]Improved Mouse Controls:[/b] Build and control troops with mouse! Building your city and setting up your troops has never been easier. Still plays great with a controller.
[*][b]Improved Hero Level-Up System:[/b] Your hero now levels up gradually throughout each level, and you can accelerate it by building Shrines and Temples. Choose between gaining new abilities or leveling up your current ones.
[*][b]Difficulty Options:[/b] Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard or Insane modes
[*][b]Exposed Stats:[/b] Many of the stats in the game have been exposed so you can make more informed decisions about your defenses
[*][b]Reworked Economy:[/b] We heard you, Spirit and Upkeep were a drag, and now they are gone! Gold is the only resource you need and upkeep has been replaced with a much less punishing repair cost.
[*][b]Revamped UI:[/b] The entire UI of the game has been reworked to be more intuitive and appealing
[*][b]Removed Scoring System:[/b] We didn’t like how the score system incentivized specific playstyles, so we removed it. Wool at the Gates is all about giving you the freedom to play how you want while completing fun challenges.
[*][b]Revamped Tutorial and Tip System:[/b] The old tutorial was tedious and gave you no freedom. Now you can learn the game with less handholding.
[*]A million other things we don’t have time to write here because we need to go finish the game!
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
We're currently focused on wrapping up the content for the Early Access version of the game, which will also include quality of life fixes, localization, and achievements. Stay tuned for the launch announcement!

We always appreciate your feedback - please continue to give it via our in-game survey, Discord, or any other way you can reach us. 

Sincerely,
Mr. & Mrs. Creature

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Wool at the Gates demo will be available during Steam Next Fest. Experience what it is like to unite Humans and Orcs against the sheep legion as an all powerful Eye God. Establish the cities of Gilia and Windrim under your rule. Plan your cities carefully while utilizing the strengths of each faction and the 9 Class types to crush the sheep rebellion. 

Be sure to reach out to let us know what you think on our [url= https://discord.gg/tKkZvRyfGg]Discord[/url] or comment on the forums on our Steam store page.

Thanks for playing!
Matt & Christine
